I’m so happy with Sherri’s service! I needed to find someone to take care of my cat immediately for at least one month, and it was very last minute, so I was nervous. I was so relieved when I found her.

She was incredibly kind, responsive, and flexible, which helped me a lot since I wasn’t sure about my exact return date. I even had to extend my cat’s stay last minute, and she was able to accommodate it. It ended up being two months total. That kind of flexibility makes a huge difference for this type of service.

She also sent me photos of my cat when I asked, which made me so happy and gave me peace of mind. Since my cat doesn’t get along with other cats and gets stressed easily, Sherri was able to keep her separated (with an additional fee), which actually worked out perfectly for us.

Her communication was always quick and professional. I truly appreciate everything she did and would absolutely recommend her to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring pet sitter!
